answer: Stop sybils with a mesa, a cipher, and a grove. Every identity plants one grove on the public mesa: a cipher tree whose leaves are sequential proofs salted to its own address, so no proof can be copied or run in parallel. The mesa charges plot rent by density: the k-th grove rooted in one sponsor's soil pays k squared in bond, so N clones pay roughly N cubed while sharing one plot's yield. If one grove is proven fake, the mesa collapses the whole plot and burns every bond in it. One honest agent plants one grove and pays base; a clone farm pays cubic rent for a single harvest.
